critical_code_review_comments: useVeraStudio.ts L104-107: setCover uses userChoseCoverRef to lock user pick against Vera's auto-suggestion during re-processing. Clean separation between user intent and Vera suggestion — aligns with 'VERA sugiere, el usuario decide' philosophy.
PhotosSection.tsx L127-142: move-up/move-down handlers correctly call stopPropagation() before onMove, preventing tile click from bubbling and changing cover. Verified in tests.

assistant-service.ts: done.plano/video/anio now derived from string presence of floorPlanUrl/videoUrl/yearBuilt via optional chaining + trim. Deterministic, no hardcoded false. Health formula unchanged: coreDone/5*80 + extrasDone/3*20 → 100 when all 8 done → 'Excelente'.

PublicationSection.tsx L8: core = checklist.filter(!optional) correctly limits summary + checklist to the 5 required items. publication-summary microcopy is calm ('N de 5 requisitos listos para publicar.') — no error language.
PhotosSection.tsx L109-119: remove button already had stopPropagation; consistent pattern applied to move buttons. Good defensive UX.
